body: This is the TENET5 daily desk package for 2026-07-11. TENET5 is an independent Canadian investigative newsroom and government-analysis desk. We read statutes, Hansard, contracts, Health Canada tables, and multi-source wires. Powered by LIRIL AI. You verify every claim against a source you can open.
Desk posture today: AMBER. Lead line: Municipal capture investigation live (52 findings / 30 cities); defence spend ladder + Griffon GLLE pause remain the federal procurement spine.

Active files on this hour's board: MUNICIPAL: How Canadian cities keep failing the public — national investigation; DEFENCE: NATO 2026 partnerships: missiles, Arctic SATCOM, spend ladder; PROCUREMENT: CH-146 Griffon GLLE ~$800M paused for reassessment; ARCTIC: Multi-decade Arctic defence infrastructure wave; INDUSTRIAL: Defence Investment Agency + Industrial Strategy in motion; 5GW MEDIA: CBC social amplification / harassment pattern — X·FB·Bluesky queues armed Each file is TENET5 analysis against primary sources — not a social headline alone.

On the multi-source external wire (labeled EXTERNAL SOURCE, not a TENET5 verdict): India, China among main perpetrators of foreign interference, new CSIS report says; Plea for Carney to leave committees alone; victim in horrific rape case tells her story;…; Heated Rivalry producer won’t send fleece to Carney until Online Streaming Act’s future…; Corporate watchdog was still accepting complaints as Carney abruptly closed it down Case claims still require primary documents.

How to read the site: time is the spine. Day is the news desk (briefing, investigations, five-act argument, MAID file). Hour is the live wire. Week holds investigations. Month is claim versus record. Year holds case files. Atmosphere film is memorial tone — not proof. Open the homepage news air desk for LIRIL's full video presentation.
